tier_should.rationale: Timely expert elicitation on AGI lab safety practices, with clear policy relevance and transparency about limitations. Non-representative sample and acquiescence-prone Likert design constrain inference and novelty. Solid fit for AI governance/policy journals, not top-general.

tier_will.rationale: High-profile participants and alignment with ongoing regulatory debates help placement. Yet methodological limits and descriptive contribution likely cap venue to solid field journals rather than top field or general outlets.
